description: Source code for the TextRenderer class, responsible for rendering text using OpenGL in an Android environment, including font bitmap handling, texture loading, string measurement, and drawing functions.

classes.name: TextRenderer
classes.description: Handles text rendering, font texture management, and string layout calculations.

methods.name: initXOffset
methods.description: Generates X offsets for glyphs based on font bitmap data.

methods.name: isPowerOfTwo
methods.description: Checks if a value is a power of two.

methods.name: powerOfTwoCeil
methods.description: Calculates the next power of two greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: loadIntoTexture
methods.description: Creates an OpenGL texture from font bitmap data.

methods.name: setProportionalScale
methods.description: Sets text scale based on screen dimensions and desired lines per screen.

methods.name: computeScaledStringWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a string when scaled.

methods.name: glyphIndex
methods.description: Returns the glyph index for a character.

methods.name: drawString
methods.description: Renders a string at specified screen coordinates.

methods.name: drawWrappedString
methods.description: Renders a string with word wrapping within screen bounds.

methods.name: breakString
methods.description: Breaks a string into a line that fits within a maximum width.
